relations.rationale: Nell finishing ahead of Ivo is independent of Ivo's relation to Kira.
Nell ahead of Ivo does not by itself establish Nell's finish relative to Kira.
Finishing order has no bearing on relative age.
Finishing order has no bearing on height.
Spectators clapping as robots cleared checkpoints doesn't indicate differences in speed among robots.
Clapping by spectators is unrelated to whether Noor specifically watched timers.
Spectators clapping has no connection to Kira's hopes for improving balance.
Watching timers closely aligns with and supports the idea that Noor noted completions carefully.
Noor watching timers has no bearing on relative height comparisons.
Noor's attentiveness to completions is unrelated to height comparisons.
Noor's careful noting of completions has no bearing on design part counts.
Ivo ahead of Kira is consistent with and supports Nell (who's ahead of Ivo per other claims) being ahead of Kira, but strictly from just this claim alone, it doesn't establish Nell's position.
Finishing order between Ivo and Kira has no bearing on the color of Noor's robot.
Finishing order is unrelated to the number of parts used in their designs.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira suggests differing performance, which contradicts the claim that their designs worked equally well.
Finishing order has no bearing on the later group gathering to compare notes.
Kira adjusting her robot's wheels after a collision aligns with and supports her hoping to improve balance next round.
Finishing order has no bearing on relative age.
Nell's age relative to Leo is independent of her age relative to Kira.
Nell's age relative to Leo has no bearing on height comparisons between Ivo and Nell.
